Make this an actual sprite built on a strict 64 by 64 logical pixel canvas, animal occupies central ~48 by 40 logical pixels, ample transparent margins, no accessories except one jade mark. Enlarge the logical pixels uniformly with nearest-neighbor for this output; no details finer than a logical pixel.
